series.name: Conceptual Depth
series.description: Calibrates the register, audience sophistication, vocabulary, and complexity scaffolding for the entire specification.

open_ended.text: What is the primary domain or field this prompt or project addresses? Describe its scope, core concerns, and any relevant sub-disciplines.

follow_up_choices.text: A single well-established domain (e.g., machine learning, civil engineering)
An emerging or niche area with evolving terminology

open_ended.text: Who is the intended audience for the generated output? What is their baseline familiarity with this domain?

follow_up_choices.text: Experts / researchers — people who work in this domain daily
Practitioners / professionals — experienced but may need refreshers
Learners / general audience — minimal assumed knowledge

open_ended.text: What foundational concepts, theorems, or prior art can the output take for granted? What must be explained from scratch?

follow_up_choices.text: Full prerequisites assumed — dive straight into advanced material
Core fundamentals assumed; edge cases and advanced topics explained
First-principles treatment — no prior knowledge assumed

open_ended.text: At what level of abstraction should the output operate? Should it be concrete and example-driven, or formal and general?

follow_up_choices.text: Concrete — specific examples, code snippets, case studies
Mixed — conceptual frameworks illustrated with examples
Formal — definitions, proofs, mathematical notation, first-order logic

open_ended.text: What vocabulary, jargon, or notation should be used or deliberately avoided? Are there established standards the output should follow?

follow_up_choices.text: Standard industry terminology — use common terms precisely
Plain accessible language — minimize jargon; explain what is used
Formal academic register — precise definitions, technical notation

open_ended.text: How should complexity be distributed across the output? Should it start simple and deepen, or maintain a consistent level throughout?

follow_up_choices.text: Progressive — scaffold from simple foundations to advanced topics
Overview-first — high-level summary then independent deep dives
